newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips recoup losses to end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips recoup losses to end little changed.

text.p: Stocks staged an impressive rally in the second session of the year Friday, sparked by strength in high-technology issues.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 101.60 points to close at 6,544.09, after falling 101 points on Tuesday and riding a rollercoaster to end little changed on Thursday. In the broader market, gainers beat losers by a 9-7 margin on active volume of about 446 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
